rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: raw STAR/featureCounts integers go straight into DESeqDataSetFromMatrix with ~condition, explicit control reference, contrast c('condition', treated, control), median-of-ratios inside the model, a minimal justified filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, smallest group), Wald test with BH at 0.05, apeglm shrinkage, and an explicit refusal of tximport, length offsets and pre-normalized values. QC precedes the test with blind VST, PCA on top 500 genes, sample-distance heatmap and library sizes; the only soft spot is that the outlier policy is descriptive (name, do not drop) without stating what T1S2 does if a shallow or discordant sample is found. Enrichment is correctly omitted as not asked, the edgeR QLF cross-check is properly subordinated with the intersection rather than the union reported, and the report lists method, versions, design, thresholds, n tested, n significant, NA categories, and the low-power caveat at n=3.
